I have $58 and three properties with two houses each. I am short of cash and lack a get-out-of-jail-free card. Opponent p3 holds a light-blue and a pink monopoly. Opponent p2 has substantial cash but no monopolies yet.

Opponent p4 holds a yellow monopoly and utilities. I recently traded away Ventnor, Water Works, and $50 for St James Place and New York Avenue.

I mortgaged Short Line and Kentucky. p4 now owns the utilities, railroads, and Park Place. p3 holds both monopolies, so it can build on either property.

I cannot mortgage, unmortgage, or build anything. I have no legal post-turn actions available.

I will end my turn. Trading away my orange properties would be unwise. I am verifying the standard Monopoly rent chart for these spaces.

I am weighing a trade to raise cash for a third house. The rent jump from two houses to three is steep, and I need roughly $300 to build evenly on all three properties.

Monopoly requires even building across a set, so three houses on every orange property is mandatory. That costs $300 total, leaving a $242 gap. I rejected trading Kentucky to p2 because that would give them a red monopoly and the cash to build hotels immediately.

p4 can unmortgage Ventnor and build on the yellow set. I will not help p2 or p4 complete dark blue, since that would be lethal. No trade improves my position, so I will end the turn.
